This year the Blebs are coming together to support 2? amazing causes! 

We're continuing the fight against living miserably, and showing our love again for CALM - the brilliant mental health charity. It's only together we can help people end their misery, not their lives. And we're also supporting War Child! They do amazing work around the world helping children who have been affected by conflict. <3

Please donate generously!

I am supporting Jingle Jam 2025 to aid remarkable charities like WarChild, who do incredible work for children affected by war. Kids should just get to be kids and not worry about the horrors happening around them. War Child do such incredible work to help kids.  I hope we can see you at our special stream on the 13th at 8pm GMT!
